'''Complications''' is a mission in {{V}}, given to [[Franklin Clinton]] by car dealer [[Simeon Yetarian]] from [[Premium Deluxe Motorsport]] in [[Pillbox Hill]], [[Los Santos (HD Universe)|Los Santos]]. Fellow protagonist [[Michael De Santa]] is also playable during the mission's final sequence.

==Description==
Simeon is seen arranging a deal with [[Mr. Kenneth]] in the front parking lot right outside his [[Premium Deluxe Motorsport|dealership]] from 8:00 to 18:00. Simeon orders Franklin to repossess a yellow [[Karin]] [[BeeJay XL]] that [[Jimmy De Santa]] bought from him from the [[De Santa Residence]]. Franklin leaves and Simeon continues to negotiate.

Before arriving at the house, Simeon will call Franklin, showing his anger after failing to deliver the [[Bagger]] from the [[Repossession|previous mission]]. Upon arriving, Franklin knocks out the [[Carlos (GTA V)|gardener]] and proceeds to sneak into the house. Franklin needs to navigate the house stealthily to avoid alerting its residents, passing through the kitchen, and entering the garage to steal the SUV. Franklin manages to successfully steal the SUV and drives away from the house back to the dealership.

Suddenly Michael, who was hidden in the SUV's backseat, points a [[Pistol|gun]] at Franklin's head and threatens him, asking him who he is working for and ordering him to continue driving back towards the dealership. Franklin stops near the dealership, and Michael then orders him to drive through the dealership window. A short [[Cutscenes|cutscene]] plays where Michael quickly gives Franklin some [[Money|cash]] and tells him to leave the scene.

The player, now controlling Michael, then has to beat up Simeon. After sufficiently beating Simeon enough, another cutscene is triggered. Michael orders Simeon to leave his son alone and then threatens him not to cross him again.

==Objectives==
*Go to the {{Color|v-hud-yellow|house.}}
*Find a way into the house.
*Take out the {{Color|v-hud-red|gardener.}}
*Retrieve the {{Color|v-hud-blue|car.}}
*Take the car to the {{Color|v-hud-yellow|dealership.}}
*Ram through the {{Color|v-hud-yellow|dealership}} window.
*Beat up {{Color|v-hud-red|Simeon.}}
*Return to the {{Color|v-hud-yellow|dealership}} before the Cops are alerted.{{Note|If attempting to leave the fight.}}

===Gold Medal Objectives===
*Mission Time - Complete within 05:00.
**Skip the cutscenes. Don't try any doors, go straight onto the [[Bison|truck]] and move quickly through the house.
**Running while aiming down the sight is the fastest way to move through the house without being detected.
*Can't Touch This - Take no damage during the fight with Simeon.
**Use the ability right before the fight starts to get an advantage and then repeatedly punch Simeon, without stopping, to stop Simeon doing counter-attacks.
**Kick Simeon to the ground instantly, then repeatedly attack him to prevent him from getting up.
*Dirt Nap - Knock out the gardener with a stealth attack.
**Jump the wall, go into stealth mode and walk over to Carlos and press either {{Button|circle}} (on [[PlayStation]] versions), {{Button|Xbox B}} (on [[Xbox]] versions) or either {{Button|lmb}} or {{Button|kbr}} (on [[Personal Computer|PC]]) once.

==Aftermath==
The player can now play as Michael, allowing the player to switch between him and Franklin, and can now also use [[De Santa Residence|Michael's mansion]] as a [[Safehouses in GTA V|safehouse]]. In addition, the [[Vanilla Unicorn|strip club]], [[Movies|cinemas]], the [[Pleasure Pier|fairground]], [[golf]], and [[tennis]] are unlocked.

*Simeon Yetarian replaces Franklin as Employee of the Month on the wall plaque.
*At some point after this mission, Lamar will text Franklin telling him he left the [[Bagger]] they [[Repossession|stole]] at his [[Clinton Residence|aunt's place]]. The next time the player returns, the bike will be there, saved as their second personal vehicle.

===Los Santos Shepherd Newspaper===
''Joyrider smashes into cars dealership in Pillbox Hill.''

''Makayla Taylor - Los Santos Shepherd''

''"Traffic accidents are common enough in [[Los Santos (HD Universe)|Los Santos]]. Traffic accidents involving parked cars are not uncommon. Traffic accidents involving cars parked inside a dealership are still unusual, however, but that is just what happened yesterday in [[Pillbox Hill]]. A deranged or possibly drunk joyrider drove his car straight into the showroom of Premium Deluxe Motorsport. The owner, Mr. Simeon Yetarian, was injured in the accident, but the driver fled the scene before [[Los Santos Police Department (HD Universe)|cops]] could get there. Mr. Yetarian told our reporter "I am a well-known philanthropist and charity worker as well as an excellent car dealer. Therefore I can only say it is greatly unfortunate that a chubby alcoholic would consider my showroom an acceptable place to crash his car. I am hoping given all the work I do in the community and especially for race relations that the city will help me pay for the damage." A spokesman for the city commented "we have no comment at this time."''

==Oversights==
*If the FPS is set too high during this mission, the [[Premier]] will shift positions slightly before [[Mr. Kenneth]] enters it, and as a result, [[Simeon Yetarian|Simeon]]'s right hand will be clipping into the Premier's roof while his left hand is resting in mid-air instead of the car's door.
**If the FPS is higher than 120, then the Premier will shift positions so much that it will automatically trigger a mission failure (with the reason being that Simeon's deal was disrupted), making it impossible to progress in this mission. 
***This was fixed with the [[GTA Online: Money Fronts|Money Fronts]] update.
*If [[Franklin Clinton|Franklin]] knocks out the [[Carlos (GTA V)|gardener]] with a stealth attack, it may still be added to his People Killed [[Statistics in GTA V|stats]].
*If Franklin looks in the back seat before entering the [[BeeJay XL|car]], it is possible to see a red blanket laid down across the seat (where Michael is hiding), although Michael cannot be made to trigger until Franklin gets into the car. Once Michael emerges, however, the red blanket will disappear completely.
*If the player uses Franklin's [[Special Ability|special ability]] when [[Michael De Santa|Michael]] sits up and puts the gun against his head, the BeeJay XL will catapult forward.
*When Michael places a [[Pistol|handgun]] to Franklin's head in the car, he refers to the gun as a 9mm, although in [[Ammu-Nation (HD Universe)|Ammu-Nation]], the gun's description says it's a .45 caliber. This is a mistake on Ammu-Nation's part as the weapon in question is based on the {{WP|Taurus PT92|Taurus PT92AF}}, which is chambered in 9mm.
*After the [[Cutscenes|cutscene]] in which Michael orders Franklin to ram the SUV through the window, the vehicle's horn sound may change.
*During the fistfight with Simeon, he may say to Michael three possible quotes: "See, now. You've pissed me off.", "Simeon Yetarian doesn't back down from anybody.", or "I won't be treated like this." None of these quotes will appear in the subtitles if they are enabled.
*At the conclusion of the mission, Michael can re-enter the [[Premium Deluxe Motorsport|dealership]] and take any of the cars on display. Strangely, however, if the player saves a car in their [[Garages|garage]], the vehicle will despawn the next time the player enters the garage.
**Coincidentally, Jimmy's crashed BeeJay XL will still be at the dealership and can be driven by the player. Unlike the vehicles stolen from the showroom, Jimmy's crashed BeeJay XL can be kept and it will be automatically repaired. However, like the vehicles inside the dealership, the BeeJay XL will disappear from the player's garage. This has been fixed in the [[Grand Theft Auto V: Enhanced Edition|enhanced version]].
*After completing the mission and heading to Michael's house as Michael, Franklin's [[Buffalo S]] may appear to still be there. It can be saved in Michael's garage. The car may appear at the place even if Franklin used any other car, but the mission's been replayed. If Michael takes a ride in Franklin's car (e.g. attempting to return the Buffalo to its owner), the latter would call Michael, asking him "what the fuck" he is doing with his car.

==Trivia==
===General===
*The gold medal objective "Can't Touch This" is likely a reference to the {{WP|MC Hammer}} song "{{WP|U Can't Touch This}}".

===''Grand Theft Auto V''===
*If the mission is started during the day, the Premier that Mr. Kenneth is attempting to purchase will be red. However, if it is started at night, the car will be yellow once the timelapse is finished.
*If Franklin enters the dealership and looks inside Simeon's office at the beginning of the mission, one will discover that Simeon already replaced Franklin's Employee of the Month plaque with one dedicated to himself.
*During the mission, two [[Tailgater]]s (one gray and one white) can be found parked outside the dealership. Franklin can choose one of them to drive to Michael's [[De Santa Residence|house]], and Michael can use one of them once the mission is complete.
*If Franklin ignores Simeon's phone call on the way to Michael's house, he will send Franklin a text message mentioning the locked garage and his suspicions of Franklin keeping the [[Bagger|motorbike]].
*During the confrontation with Simeon, Michael will claim that the latter sold the [[BeeJay XL]] to Jimmy for $5,000 a month. In {{O}}, the SUV could originally be bought from [[Southern San Andreas Super Autos]] for $27,000 flat before it was removed from the in-game website in the [[GTA Online: San Andreas Mercenaries|San Andreas Mercenaries]] update.
*At the end of the cutscene with Michael beating up Simeon, Michael throws Simeon onto the floor. However, Simeon disappears after the cutscene is finished.
*Using stealth, it's possible to explore the mansion without being spotted. Aside from [[Amanda De Santa|Amanda]] flirting with her [[tennis]] [[Kyle Chavis|coach]] in the kitchen, [[Jimmy De Santa|Jimmy]] can be observed in his room playing video games, and [[Tracey De Santa|Tracey]] will be lying on her bed, talking on the phone with her friend [[Lara (GTA V)|Lara]] (but her back will be conveniently facing the door). Jimmy is so distracted by the game, it's actually possible for Franklin to stand in the doorway and not be noticed.
**Approaching any resident of Michael's house will result in a unique mission fail cutscene.
*After the phone call to Simeon once the player enters the SUV is finished, Franklin will be unable to use his [[Mobile Phone|cell phone]] until the mission is complete.
*If the player damages [[Jimmy De Santa|Jimmy]]'s car before entering it, Michael will stand up immediately when Franklin enters the car. This will skip a phone call between Franklin and Simeon and change Michael's quote from ''"You just keep driving where you're going."'' to ''"Take me where you were going."''
**This will also happen if Franklin tries to exit the car before making the phone call.
*When getting back to the dealership while Michael holds Franklin at gunpoint, [[First-Person View|first-person mode]] is disabled as Franklin is forced to look forward. If the player enters the SUV while first-person mode is active, the camera will automatically switch to [[Third-Person View|third-person mode]] when Michael points his pistol at Franklin's head. First-person view will be restored during the fistfight with Simeon.
*If the player drives too far from the dealership or goes a different way to the way Michael wants Franklin to go, he will knock Franklin out by hitting his right temple with his pistol and the mission will fail.
*When the player crashes into Simeon's dealership, the BeeJay XL they are driving has a noticeably more aggressive engine tone. This is due to a unique sound effect played over the scene.
*During Franklin's phone call to Lamar upon completion of the mission, a topless black [[Mesa]] can be found parked behind him. It can be taken afterwards.
*In the [[Beta Content in GTA V|beta version]], Franklin was going to climb the vines to get into Michael's house.{{Ref|name=vines|type=screenshot|image=Complications-GTAV-BetaAccess.PNG|imagesize=200px}}
